top_predictions.formatted_name: Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus

agronomic_advisory.symptoms: Small, dark brown to black circular lesions (1-3mm), often with greasy or water-soaked borders and conspicuous yellow chlorotic halos.
agronomic_advisory.action_plan: Prune spotted leaves with sanitized shears. Avoid handling plants when wet. Apply fixed copper bactericide.
organic_remedies: Hydrogen dioxide / peroxyacetic acid sanitation spray
chemical_remedies: Copper Oxychloride (50% WP) 2.5 g/L + Mancozeb 2.0 g/L
cultural_practices: Use certified pathogen-free hot-water treated tomato seeds
Sterilize pruning shears with 70% isopropyl alcohol between rows
Eliminate solanaceous weeds (nightshade) around the greenhouse/field
Never work or prune in tomato fields while leaves are wet
